title: Neovim's Mason installs nothing into a root that does not exist yet
foundBy: session agent, setting up this repo's Neovim config on a host without /opt/nvim/mason
details:
`lua/plugins/mason.lua` treats its Mason root as read-only when the directory is missing, because `vim.uv.fs_access()` returns false for a missing path. A read-only root turns off Mason's registry refresh, so the registry is never downloaded. `:MasonInstallSync!` then fails with `Cannot find package "html"`, and nothing installs.

It happens to any root that nobody created in advance. One is `$MASON_ROOT` pointed at a new directory, which SPEC.md offers for a private writable package set. Another is the `stdpath("data")/mason` fallback on a host without /opt/nvim/mason. The image build never sees it, because it creates /opt/nvim/mason before the pre-build.
